newsitem.title: USA: LaCrosse Footwear Q1 net up on sales spike.
newsitem.headline: LaCrosse Footwear Q1 net up on sales spike.

text.p: LaCrosse Footwear Inc said Thursday its earnings in the first quarter ended March 29 rose sharply thanks in part to higher sales in the period.

The protective footwear and rainwear manufacturer said net income reached $545,000, or $0.08 a share, compared with $297,000, or $0.04 a share, in the first quarter of 1996. Sales increased to $32.7 million from $22.1 million.
LaCrosse said the sales increase was primarily driven by the inclusion of results of Rainfair Inc and the Red Ball product line, both of which it acquired in May of 1996.
The company also said advance orders for the first quarter of 1997 are ahead of the pace set in 1996.
LaCrosse shares were up 1/2 Thursday at 11-3/4.
